# Hard fixture: TB-303 ladder rung (or full ladder)

Suggested circuit: one or more rungs of the TB-303 transistor ladder VCF.
30-60 components, dense feedback, requires symmetry to be readable.

The hard fixture is where pattern recognition (Phase 5) becomes essential.
Bare ELK and bare HOLA will both produce something legible-but-not-great;
a working ladder-rung pattern template should make a visible difference.
